NBA DFS Rankings for Tuesday, October 20 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Tuesday, October 20 · 3 games · First game 3:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 20, 2:45 PM ET

Victor Wembanyama (SAS) ranks first on the Tuesday, October 20 DraftKings main slate at 57.2 projected DraftKings points for $10,500. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC, 49.8) and Jayson Tatum (BOS, 49.3) are next.

The table ranks all 39 players in the run by SPAGS projection, with DraftKings salary and projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 20, 2:45 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.
